concerns.text: Constitution Principle III requires that every dataset be checksummed and the checksum recorded under `data/`. No task creates or verifies checksums for any data files (e.g., `data/raw/stimuli.csv`, `data/raw/ratings.csv`, `data/raw/real_ratings.csv`). This omission violates the Data Hygiene principle.

Constitution Principle VI mandates that all datasets containing human ratings be stripped of Personally Identifying Information (PII) before storage. The real data ingestion task (`T015b-Code`) reads Prolific IDs but does not specify any hashing, removal, or anonymization step, nor is there a separate task that performs PII stripping. This constitutes a breach of the Human‑Subject Anonymity and Consent principle.
